rule.description: The PDF/UA version and conformance level of a file shall be specified using the PDF/UA Identification extension schema

rule.description: If the Lang entry is present in the document's Catalog dictionary or in a structure element dictionary or property list, its value shall be a language identifier as described in ISO 32000-1:2008, 14.9.2.
